target.preferredDefinition: One homogeneous senior-career total per player: official senior club competitions plus recognised senior A-international matches, with the source's inclusion and cutoff rules preserved.
requiredProperties: one documented definition for every row
stable player identity or enough provenance to reconcile it
published permission to use or redistribute the data in a commercial game

decision.reason: No candidate currently proves both 200 homogeneous rows and a usable redistribution right. No source has been padded or mixed with another source.

sources.name: StrikerDuel

license.documentedTerms: Annual, non-exclusive licence delivered as a versioned API or scheduled feed; attribution required. Redistribution, sublicensing and building a competing derivative database are explicitly excluded without the licence arrangement.

sources.definition: Career totals are split into club, international and combined totals. The methodology says the records are compiled primarily from per-season club and international tables on Wikipedia, normalised, reviewed by hand, and that unofficial matches are excluded; official competition totals are preferred where sources disagree.
sources.evidence: The licensing page reports 134 profiled players and the rankings page exposes a Top 50 goals list.

sources.name: SportBaseline All-Time Record Book

license.documentedTerms: The public record page does not state a data licence or redistribution permission. A direct retrieval on the review date returned HTTP 403, so no additional terms were assumed.

sources.definition: The page labels the metric as senior career goals across all club and international competitions in its dataset.
sources.evidence: The page exposes ranks 1–50 for most career goals; the 1.9M season-stat claim is not itself a 200-row export or a redistribution licence.

sources.name: RSSSF Prolific Scorers

license.documentedTerms: The page identifies historical sources and editorial notes but does not grant Rango 90 a commercial redistribution licence.

sources.definition: Its broad Official Matches block includes regional, reserve and amateur leagues, national and international cups, A/B/Ol/U and other selections, select matches and other historical tournaments. Its separate Top level block is explicitly marked preliminary.
sources.evidence: The page itself says it contains only famous players with verified statistics and notes that other players may have 500 or more goals.

sources.name: IFFHS all-time top-level goal scorers

license.documentedTerms: The publisher's page is a reference ranking and does not grant a commercial redistribution licence to Rango 90.

sources.definition: Top-level senior club and national-team categories, with the published table restricted to players reaching the source's historical threshold of 500 or more top-level goals.
sources.evidence: The publication describes an inclusion threshold rather than an exhaustive 200-player export.

sources.name: salimt/football-datasets

license.documentedTerms: The repository README advertises a licence badge, but the referenced LICENSE file and GitHub licence endpoint were not present/retrievable on the review date. The data is described as sourced from Transfermarkt, so repository code/data availability is not treated as permission to redistribute the underlying data.

sources.definition: The repository contains per-season player performance rows and national-team performance rows, but it does not publish an exhaustive global career-goals ranking with a single senior-career inclusion rule.
sources.evidence: The repository schema is useful for research, but its source, licence and coverage do not establish a publishable 200-row career-goals ranking.

sources.name: football.db / Open Football Data

license.documentedTerms: The schema, data and scripts are dedicated to the public domain.

sources.definition: Open match schedules/results and selected scorer lines in Football.TXT; it is not an exhaustive player career-statistics feed.
sources.evidence: The project documents fixtures/results and a public-domain schema, not a complete all-competition senior player-goals table.
